errors.text_span: Секторите са визуално подредени, като по-големият сектор е отляво и по-малкият сектор е отдясно.
errors.evidence: The phrase 'визуално подредени' (visually ordered) is misleading as it implies a deliberate sorting principle (like size), which is not the primary characteristic of the layout. Furthermore, describing the large sector as simply 'on the left' and the small one as 'on the right' is an oversimplification of their positions, as the large red sector occupies the top and left portions of the circle, while the blue one is in the bottom-right.
